verdict.rationale: Quo's own API returns data as standardized JSON, an open format. Its API and MCP server can pull message history, call history, voicemail transcripts and contacts. That gives a programmatic way to extract core data, but nothing documents a dedicated full-account export or an offboarding path. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of all account data, coverage of every data type (recordings, settings, AI summaries without plan gating), export-format documentation, an account-leaving or data-portability policy, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
